## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the `--exclude` environment default before merge so CI jobs can configure exclusions through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by basename and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Critical

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser defaults to `[]` and archives `build.log`. The rule at `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` says each new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment include files they intended to skip.

## Suggestions

- tests/test_main.py:24 — tests — Test the default through the archive contents — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` unset and no `--exclude` argument, this assertion fails if the parser returns `None` and `main` maps it to no patterns, even though the archive contents stay the same. — The test can block a behavior-preserving parser refactor while leaving the default archive contents unverified.
